name: claude-spec-driven-dev-plugin
description: Spec-driven development workflow plugin for Claude Code

plugins.name: spec-driven-development
plugins.description: Spec-driven development workflow: steering documents, feature specs (requirements/design/tasks/review-log), verification, and agent-based implementation on a generator/arbiter split — the main agent arbitrates while persistent subagent sessions author, implement (parallel groups by file-disjointness), test, and review to 0 issues. Tests are specified as spec-anchored cases in design.md and written by a dedicated agent kept blind to the implementation, so the suite survives refactoring instead of rotting. Enforces 'no spec, no code' discipline, with a project backlog for deferred discoveries and an advisor gate that settles clear-cut decisions instead of interrupting the user. Executor sessions are bounded on two axes the harness enforces: a per-agent maxTurns ceiling that returns an over-large dispatch partial instead of running it to exhaustion, and a context checkpoint that retires a session at 400K — far below the point the harness would autocompact it, so an executor never ends up working from a summary of its own design basis.
